tasks.name: Dense Vector Cosine Similarity Nearest Neighbors (Top-K ANN)
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
-- Find the top 2 documents closest to the query embedding [0.9, 0.1, 0.25, 0.0]
            WITH scored_docs AS (
                SELECT 
                    doc_id,
                    title,
                    embedding,
                    -- Native SIMD cosine similarity
                    array_cosine_similarity(embedding, [0.9, 0.1, 0.25, 0.0]::FLOAT[4]) AS cosine_score
                FROM doc_embeddings
            )
            SELECT 
                doc_id,
                title,
                ROUND(cosine_score, 4) AS similarity_score
            FROM scored_docs
            ORDER BY cosine_score DESC
            LIMIT 2;
